Lemma
[Geometric fibration of a neck chain by two-spheres] ↗ def:chain-of-epsilon-necks

There is $\epsilon _0>0$ such that the following holds for all $0<\epsilon \le \epsilon _0$. Suppose that $\{ N_j\} _{j\in J}$ is a chain of $\epsilon $-necks in a Riemannian manifold $M$. Let $U=\cup _{j\in J}N_j$. Then there exist an interval $I$ and a smooth map $p\colon U\to I$ such that every fiber of $p$ is a two-sphere, and if $y$ is in the middle $7/8$'s of $N_j$ then the fiber $p^{-1}(p(y))$ makes a small angle at every point with the family of two-spheres in the $\epsilon $-neck $N_j$.
